verdict.rationale: Several evidence items were retrieved from https://apidocs.anrok.com/openapi.yaml, which indicates a machine-readable OpenAPI YAML spec is served at a downloadable URL. However, no first-party doc explicitly advertises or links the spec for download, and the probe found 404s on the common JSON locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known). That probe tested different paths, so it does not contradict the YAML file. missing for 10: explicit documentation advertising the downloadable spec, a JSON variant or discoverable well-known path, versioning/completeness details for the spec, independent or hands-on confirmation of using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use Anrok's Transactions API to synchronize transactions between Anrok and your billing system, as well as calculate sales tax for new invoices.
The Anrok Address Resolution endpoint resolves a customer address to its normalized form, suitable for sales tax calculations, as well as taxable jurisdiction(s).
Certificates can be uploaded to Anrok via the Anrok UI as well as via the API.
